original_evaluation.ci_method: percentile bootstrap by original study, not by augmented image
original_evaluation.score_note: continuous rule-derived ranking scores, not calibrated clinical probabilities
original_evaluation.timing_scope: warm branches; includes DICOM read and geometric postprocessing, excludes initial checkpoint loading
original_evaluation.undefined_outputs: abstentions excluded from task metrics and reported through coverage; they are not counted as correct
original_evaluation.threshold_calibration: inner validation only; outer benchmark never used to choose rotation threshold
original_evaluation.label_sources: corrected organizer manifest for existing flags; hip positioning computed from authoritative visual landmarks because the organizer table has no separate positioning field

synthetic_evaluation.scope: synthetic robustness only; reported separately from original validation; generated labels inherit remaining annotation limitations
synthetic_evaluation.spacing: known transformed nominal spacing from augmentation manifest; rotation threshold converted through mm²

localization.scope: decoded localization, correctly routed originals only; trochanter reference mask derived from manual curves; nominal physical spacing

shared256.outer_scope: previously inspected fold 0 benchmark; not a new independent test

coordinate256.outer_scope: previously inspected fold 0 benchmark; not a new independent test

coordinate_variant_synthetic.scope: synthetic robustness only; reported separately from original validation; generated labels inherit remaining annotation limitations
coordinate_variant_synthetic.spacing: known transformed nominal spacing from augmentation manifest; rotation threshold converted through mm²
